status: stage 2 implemented and under verification; stage 3 model downloads and stage 4 embedding comparison require separate owner approval

runtime.package: @huggingface/transformers@4.3.2 (pinned in package.json and package-lock.json; not required for resolver A tests; model inference remains disabled until stage 3)

preprocessing.L0: NFC, lowercase, strip punctuation, collapse whitespace
preprocessing.L1: L0 + rule-based transliteration and key folding (specs/normalisation.v1.1.md section 3)

decision.scoreC: max cosine between query and the intent's anchor embeddings
decision.rule: navigate if top1 >= tau AND top1 - top2 >= delta; ask (intents within delta of top1, max 3) if top1 >= tau AND margin < delta; otherwise not-understood
decision.selection: on TUNING only: maximise correct-navigate subject to wrong-navigate <= 2% and reject-items navigated = 0; tie-break larger delta then larger tau
decision.freeze: chosen (tau, delta) per resolver x level written to results/<runId>/thresholds.json BEFORE the test file is opened

gate.appliesTo: every language bucket (en, hi-Deva, hi-Latn, mixed), test set, best A vs each C at the same level
